text.offer: Rook says, "Hut! You swing that weapon like it owes you money. Nobody's born knowing how to fight: you learn it, from someone who already does. That's me. Right-click me and choose Buy: you'll see the skills I can teach you, from dodging a blow to a proper sword grip. Pick one you can afford and I'll drill it into you."
text.progress: Rook says, "Right-click me and choose Buy. The skills are on my list beside the steel. Dodge or a proficiency with the weapon you carry is a good start."
text.complete: Rook says, "There. A skill starts out weak and grows every time you use it, so get out there and use it. Here, take a little of your coin back. Spend it on the next lesson."

steps.brief: Rook teaches fighting skills to anyone who can pay. Right-click him and choose Buy to see them beside his weapons and armour. Trainers all over Meridian teach skills and spells this way.
